notes: Tapping Measure collapsed the Convert / Measure switch at the top of the screen to a 2px sliver, so Convert was gone and you were stuck: the switch is the one panel on that screen whose rounded corners clip it, and a screen the size of the Measure view was squeezing it flat. It now holds its size and stays pinned, so Convert is always one tap away.
The sensor permission panel always comes down. Denying motion & orientation access used to leave a full-screen panel over the app forever - every tab gone, every tap swallowed.
MeasureT now checks for new releases on every start, in Settings → Updates, and shows what the release changed before it applies.
Updates arrive while the app runs: the page now loads newest-first and falls back to the saved copy only when the network is gone, instead of pinning the first copy it ever saw.
